title: Cohort-Anchored HonestDiD
abstract: arXiv:2509.01829v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: HonestDiD sensitivity analysis (Rambachan and Roth, 2023) is usually applied to event-study coefficients aggregated across cohorts. Under staggered adoption, the treated cohorts contributing to these coefficients change with event time, as do their control groups with estimators that use not-yet-treated units. Therefore, the restriction on the aggregated coefficients and the corresponding inference does not have a clear interpretation. This paper proposes to do the HonestDiD sensitivity analysis on a cohort basis. The restriction is placed on each cohort's block bias, which captures its violation of parallel trends relative to the units untreated when it first adopts treatment. The restriction on the block bias maps to the restriction on the estimation bias through an invertible linear decomposition. translated_abstract: HonestDiD敏感性分析（Rambachan和Roth，2023）通常应用于跨队列汇总的事件研究系数。在交错采用处理的设计下，对这些系数有贡献的受处理队列会随事件时间而变化，在使用尚未处理单位作为对照组的估计量中，其对照组也随之变化。因此，对汇总系数施加的限制及相应的推断缺乏明确的解释。本文提出在队列基础上进行HonestDiD敏感性分析。该限制被施加于每个队列的块偏差上，块偏差刻画了该队列相对于其首次采用处理时仍未受处理单位的平行趋势违背程度。通过一个可逆的线性分解，对块偏差的限制可映射为对估计偏差的限制。在模拟中，当平行趋势违背在各队列之间存在差异时，所提出的队列推断方法能够保持名义覆盖水平。
tldr: 本文提出在队列层面进行HonestDiD敏感性分析，将平行趋势违背限制施加于每个队列的块偏差，并通过可逆线性分解将其映射到估计偏差限制，从而解决了交错采用设计下对跨队列汇总系数施加限制时解释不清的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes cohort-level HonestDiD sensitivity analysis by imposing restrictions on each cohort's block bias, which maps to estimation bias restrictions through an invertible linear decomposition, resolving the unclear interpretation of restrictions on aggregated event-study coefficients under staggered adoption.
